apps.message:
fix(entry): Elektrizität stores the tutor way on the device

## Intent

The Elektrizität app now remembers the chosen tutor way in the browser. Its catalog entry should say what the app really does, as the rule entry-fitness-matches asks.

## Key changes

- fitness.storage of the entry is device instead of none. The app writes to localStorage only after a learner chooses a way.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Follows the app's update to the runtime of app-templates#30 (i168).
